segments.text: Businesses joining the refill scheme must provide tap water without requiring a purchase.
Each location will receive a window sticker after a basic hygiene inspection.
Staff should rinse reusable bottles only when a customer requests it.
Any interruption to water service must be reported through the council portal.
The first review will compare participation records after twelve weeks.
